decisions.choice: the commanders of the army: the leaders of the army, or possibly the leaders of the service
decisions.reason: The words are the usual title for army commanders (1 Chronicles 27:3; 2 Samuel 24:2), and leaders of the army may have shared in a national act like this one, as all the leaders of Israel did in 23:2. But the word for "army" is also used of the Levites' duty at the sanctuary (Numbers 4:3, 23; 8:24-25), so the phrase may here mean the leaders in charge of that service. The text does not settle which is meant.

decisions.choice: prophesied: spoke inspired words in worship, with music
decisions.reason: To prophesy is to speak as one moved by God. Here it is joined to instruments, and verse 3 explains it as giving thanks and praising the LORD. Music and prophecy go together elsewhere too (1 Samuel 10:5; 2 Kings 3:15). The singers' praise is presented as inspired speech, not only as skilled performance.

decisions.choice: lyres, harps and cymbals: the temple's string and percussion instruments
decisions.reason: The lyre and the harp were stringed instruments, the lyre the smaller; cymbals were struck metal plates. They are the instruments David assigned to the Levite musicians when the ark came to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 13:8; 15:16).

decisions.choice: their number: the list that follows
decisions.reason: "Their number" introduces the names in verses 2-4 rather than a total; the total comes in verse 7.

decisions.choice: Their work was to prophesy with music as they played
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain that the prophesying was done through the music, as verse 3 says, and splits the sentence.

decisions.choice: "prophétiser" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the usual one for prophesying, and verse 3 says what it was here; French keeps the verb, as the English does, and Readable adds "en musique".

decisions.choice: waliotoa unabii
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says these musicians "prophesied"; the Swahili keeps "kutoa unabii" at every level, as the English does, and Readable adds that they did it with music.

decisions.choice: "nói tiên tri"
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary one for prophesying; the Vietnamese keeps it at every level, and Readable adds "qua âm nhạc", as the English Readable says "with music".

decisions.choice: "예언하다"; "수금, 비파, 심벌즈"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is the one used for prophets; the Korean keeps "예언하다" at every level, and Readable says it was done with music, as the English Readable does. The instrument names are those of 15:16 and 16:5.

decisions.choice: profetizar com liras, harpas e címbalos (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "profetizar" is kept for the singers' inspired praise (m2), as 1 Samuel 10:5 has it in Portuguese for prophets with instruments, since verse 3 says what it means. The instruments keep the words set at 15:16, "lira" for the smaller stringed instrument and "harpa" for the larger (m3), here in the Hebrew order, lyres first; verse 6 lists them the other way round, as its Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: Asafe, Hemã, Jedutum
decisions.reason: The three heads of the singers keep the forms of 15:17 and 9:16 in Portuguese; Jeduthun is "Jedutum" as in 9:16.

records.literal_gloss: Of [the] sons of Asaph: Zaccur and Joseph and Nethaniah and Asarelah, sons of Asaph, on [the] hand of Asaph the prophesying on [the] hands of the king.

en.L: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur and Joseph and Nethaniah and Asarelah, [the] sons of Asaph, under [the] hand of Asaph, who prophesied under [the] hands of the king.
en.B: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. These sons of Asaph worked under Asaph's direction, and he prophesied at the king's direction.
en.R: Asaph's sons were Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. Asaph led them, and he prophesied as the king directed.

es.L: De los hijos de Asaf: Zacur y José y Netanías y Asarela, hijos de Asaf, bajo la mano de Asaf, que profetizaba bajo las manos del rey.
es.B: De los hijos de Asaf: Zacur, José, Netanías y Asarela. Estos hijos de Asaf trabajaban bajo la dirección de Asaf, y él profetizaba bajo la dirección del rey.
es.R: Los hijos de Asaf eran Zacur, José, Netanías y Asarela. Asaf los dirigía, y él profetizaba según las indicaciones del rey.

fr.L: Des fils d’Asaph : Zakkour, et Joseph, et Netania, et Asarela, fils d’Asaph, sous la main d’Asaph, qui prophétisait sous les mains du roi.
fr.B: Des fils d’Asaph : Zakkour, Joseph, Netania et Asarela. Ces fils d’Asaph travaillaient sous la direction d’Asaph, qui prophétisait sous la direction du roi.
fr.R: Les fils d’Asaph étaient Zakkour, Joseph, Netania et Asarela. Asaph les dirigeait, et il prophétisait selon les instructions du roi.

sw.L: Wa wana wa Asafu: Zakuri na Yusufu na Nethania na Asarela, wana wa Asafu, chini ya mkono wa Asafu, aliyetoa unabii chini ya mikono ya mfalme.
sw.B: Wa wana wa Asafu: Zakuri, Yusufu, Nethania na Asarela. Wana hawa wa Asafu walifanya kazi chini ya uongozi wa Asafu, naye alitoa unabii chini ya uongozi wa mfalme.
sw.R: Wana wa Asafu walikuwa Zakuri, Yusufu, Nethania na Asarela. Asafu aliwaongoza, naye alitoa unabii kama mfalme alivyoelekeza.

vi.L: Thuộc các con trai A-sáp: Xác-cua, Giô-sép, Nê-tha-nia và A-sa-rê-la, các con trai A-sáp, dưới tay A-sáp, là người nói tiên tri dưới tay vua.
vi.B: Thuộc các con trai A-sáp: Xác-cua, Giô-sép, Nê-tha-nia và A-sa-rê-la. Các con trai A-sáp này làm việc dưới sự hướng dẫn của A-sáp, còn A-sáp nói tiên tri theo sự hướng dẫn của vua.
vi.R: Các con trai của A-sáp là Xác-cua, Giô-sép, Nê-tha-nia và A-sa-rê-la. A-sáp hướng dẫn họ, và ông nói tiên tri theo sự chỉ dẫn của vua.

ko.L: 아삽의 아들들 가운데 삭굴과 요셉과 느다냐와 아사렐라, 아삽의 아들들은 아삽의 손 아래 [있었고], 아삽은 왕의 손 아래서 예언했다.
ko.B: 아삽의 아들들 가운데서는 삭굴, 요셉, 느다냐, 아사렐라이다. 아삽의 이 아들들은 아삽의 지휘를 받았고, 아삽은 왕의 지시를 받아 예언했다.
ko.R: 아삽의 아들들은 삭굴과 요셉과 느다냐와 아사렐라였다. 아삽이 그들을 이끌었고, 아삽은 왕이 지시하는 대로 예언했다.

pt.L: Dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, e José, e Netanias, e Asarela, os filhos de Asafe, sob a mão de Asafe, que profetizava sob as mãos do rei.
pt.B: Dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, José, Netanias e Asarela. Esses filhos de Asafe trabalhavam sob a direção de Asafe, e ele profetizava sob a direção do rei.
pt.R: Os filhos de Asafe foram Zacur, José, Netanias e Asarela. Asafe os dirigia, e ele profetizava conforme o rei orientava.

decisions.choice: under the hand of: under the direction of
decisions.reason: "On the hand of" means under someone's charge or leadership. The sons worked under their father, and Asaph worked under the king, who had arranged the music for worship (verse 6; 1 Chronicles 6:16).

decisions.choice: who prophesied: Asaph himself
decisions.reason: The verb form is singular, so it describes Asaph, not his sons.

decisions.choice: under Asaph's direction, at the king's direction; led them, as the king directed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the picture "under the hand" in plain words.

decisions.choice: bajo la mano de
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "under the hand of"; Balanced and Readable say "under the direction of".

decisions.choice: "손 아래"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture "under the hand"; Balanced and Readable say "direction", as the English does.

decisions.choice: sob a mão de (L); sob a direção de (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the hand with "sob", the Portuguese for being under someone's charge, since "na mão de" would mean being in someone's power; Balanced and Readable give the sense, as the English does (m1). The same holds in verses 3 and 6.

records.literal_gloss: Of Jeduthun: [the] sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah and Zeri and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six, on [the] hands of their father Jeduthun with the lyre, the prophesying in giving thanks and praising to Yahweh.

en.L: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah and Zeri and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six, under [the] hands of their father Jeduthun, with the lyre, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre, giving thanks and praise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Jeduthun's sons were Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all. Their father Jeduthun led them. He prophesied as he played the lyre, thanking and praising {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: De Jedutún: los hijos de Jedutún: Gedalías y Zeri y Jesaías, Hasabías y Matatías, seis, bajo las manos de su padre Jedutún, con la lira, que profetizaba dando gracias y alabando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: De Jedutún, los hijos de Jedutún: Gedalías, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabías y Matatías, seis, bajo la dirección de su padre Jedutún, que profetizaba con la lira, dando gracias y alabanza {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los hijos de Jedutún eran Gedalías, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabías y Matatías, seis en total. Su padre Jedutún los dirigía. Él profetizaba mientras tocaba la lira, dando gracias y alabando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: De Yedoutoun : les fils de Yedoutoun : Guedalia, et Tseri, et Yeshaya, Hashabia et Mattitya, six, sous les mains de leur père Yedoutoun, avec la lyre, qui prophétisait en rendant grâce et en louant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: De Yedoutoun, les fils de Yedoutoun : Guedalia, Tseri, Yeshaya, Hashabia et Mattitya, six, sous la direction de leur père Yedoutoun, qui prophétisait avec la lyre pour rendre grâce et louer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les fils de Yedoutoun étaient Guedalia, Tseri, Yeshaya, Hashabia et Mattitya, six en tout. Leur père Yedoutoun les dirigeait. Il prophétisait en jouant de la lyre, pour remercier et louer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wa Yeduthuni: wana wa Yeduthuni: Gedalia na Seri na Yeshaya, Hashabia na Matithia, sita, chini ya mikono ya baba yao Yeduthuni, kwa kinubi, aliyetoa unabii katika kumshukuru na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Wa Yeduthuni, wana wa Yeduthuni: Gedalia, Seri, Yeshaya, Hashabia na Matithia, sita, chini ya uongozi wa baba yao Yeduthuni, aliyetoa unabii kwa kinubi, akimshukuru na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wana wa Yeduthuni walikuwa Gedalia, Seri, Yeshaya, Hashabia na Matithia, sita kwa jumla. Baba yao Yeduthuni aliwaongoza. Yeye alitoa unabii huku akipiga kinubi, akimshukuru na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Thuộc Giê-đu-thun, các con trai Giê-đu-thun: Ghê-đa-lia, Xê-ri, Giê-sa-gia, Ha-sa-bia và Ma-ti-thia, sáu [người], dưới tay cha họ là Giê-đu-thun, với đàn lia, là người nói tiên tri khi cảm tạ và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Thuộc Giê-đu-thun, các con trai Giê-đu-thun: Ghê-đa-lia, Xê-ri, Giê-sa-gia, Ha-sa-bia và Ma-ti-thia, sáu người, dưới sự hướng dẫn của cha họ là Giê-đu-thun, người nói tiên tri với đàn lia, cảm tạ và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các con trai của Giê-đu-thun là Ghê-đa-lia, Xê-ri, Giê-sa-gia, Ha-sa-bia và Ma-ti-thia, tất cả là sáu người. Giê-đu-thun, cha họ, hướng dẫn họ. Ông vừa chơi đàn lia vừa nói tiên tri, cảm tạ và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 여두둔에게서는, 여두둔의 아들들 그달리야와 스리와 여사야, 하사뱌와 맛디디야, 여섯은 그들의 아버지 여두둔의 손 아래 [있었는데], 그는 수금으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하고 찬양하며 예언했다.
ko.B: 여두둔에게서는, 여두둔의 아들들인 그달리야, 스리, 여사야, 하사뱌, 맛디디야, 모두 여섯이 그들의 아버지 여두둔의 지휘를 받았다. 여두둔은 수금을 타며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하고 찬양하며 예언했다.

decisions.choice: the last nine names: names, which may also form a line of poetry
alternatives: read the words as a line of poetry
decisions.reason: Read as ordinary words rather than names, the names from Hananiah to Mahazioth sound like a short prayer: roughly "Be gracious to me, Yah, be gracious to me; you are my God; I have magnified, and I have exalted help; sitting in hardship, I have spoken; give visions in plenty." Some forms would need small changes to read this way, and it is not known whether the names were given to fit a known psalm, whether a line of song was later read as names, or whether the likeness is chance. The verse presents them as the names of Heman's sons, and verses 23-31 use them as names, so they are kept as names.

decisions.choice: Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth
decisions.reason: In the lots these sons are called Azarel (verse 18), Shubael (verse 20) and Jeremoth (verse 22). The pairs are spelling or form variants of the same names, as Zeri and Izri are (verses 3, 11).

decisions.choice: Romamti-Ezer
decisions.reason: The name is written as two words in the Hebrew; it is given as one hyphenated name, as the source data spells it.

decisions.choice: Buquias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jerimote, Hananias, Hanani, Eliatá, Gidalti, Romanti-Ezer, Josbecasa, Maloti, Hotir, Maaziote; Zacur, José, Netanias, Asarela (verse 2); Gedalias, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabias, Matitias (verse 3)
decisions.reason: The singers' names keep forms already drafted where there is one ("Zacur" as Numbers 13:4, "Netanias" and "Gedalias" as 2 Kings 25:23, "Matanias" as 2 Kings 24:17, "Hanani" as 1 Kings 16:1, "Hasabias", "Matitias", "Jesaías", "Hananias" as chapters 3, 6, 9 and 15), and otherwise the usual Brazilian patterns. Romamti-Ezer is one hyphenated name, as the English writes it (r-en-1): "Romanti-Ezer", with "n" before the "t" as Portuguese spells it and "-ezer" as in "Abiezer" and "Hadadezer". The last nine names may also read as a line of prayer (m1); Portuguese, like the English, keeps them as names. The rarer forms await a reviewer.

decisions.choice: in the words of God, to lift up the horn: by God's promise to make Heman strong and honored
alternatives: the seer who spoke God's words to exalt the king
to raise praise, or sound the horn, in God's service
decisions.reason: An animal's horn is a picture of strength and honor, and "lifting up the horn" means giving someone strength and standing (1 Samuel 2:1, 10; Psalm 89:18, 25). The large family that follows seems to be how God kept that promise to Heman. The phrase could instead go with "seer" (Heman as the seer who spoke God's words to lift up the king's strength), or refer to raising praise, or even to sounding a horn in music. The reading taken links it to the gift of sons in the next clause.

decisions.choice: seer: a prophet who receives visions
decisions.reason: The word comes from the verb "see" and names someone who receives messages from God by vision. Gad is called David's seer with the same word (1 Chronicles 21:9). Heman is called the king's seer because he served David.

decisions.choice: fourteen sons and three daughters
decisions.reason: Many children were counted a mark of God's blessing (Psalm 127:3-5). The fourteen sons are those named in verse 4.

decisions.choice: his horn
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies "his", taking the horn to be Heman's (see the footnote).

decisions.choice: the king's seer (a prophet who received messages from God); to make Heman strong and honored
decisions.reason: Readable explains "seer" once and gives the sense of the picture of the horn.

decisions.reason: The picture of the raised horn is kept at Literal and Balanced, as the English does; Readable says what it means.

decisions.reason: The horn is a picture of strength and honour; Literal and Balanced keep the picture, as the English does, and Readable says what it means.

decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the picture of the lifted horn, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep "뿔".

decisions.choice: levantar [o] chifre (L); exaltar o seu poder (B); tornar Hemã forte e honrado (R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Samuel 2:1 and 2:10 in Portuguese: Literal keeps the picture of the horn (m1), and Balanced gives its sense, "poder", because "chifre" in everyday Brazilian speech suggests a betrayed husband. "O vidente" is the word of 1 Samuel 9:9 (m2), which Readable explains, as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: All these [were] on [the] hands of their father in the song [of the] house of Yahweh, with cymbals, harps and lyres, for [the] service of [the] house of the God, on [the] hands of the king, Asaph and Jeduthun and Heman.

en.L: All these [were] under [the] hands of their father for the song [in the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, with cymbals, harps and lyres, for [the] service of the house of God, under [the] hands of the king: Asaph and Jeduthun and Heman.

en.R: All these men were led by their own fathers in making music in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They played cymbals, harps and lyres as part of the service in God's house. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman took their directions from the king.

fr.R: Tous ces hommes étaient dirigés par leur propre père quand ils faisaient de la musique dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. sw.B: Hawa wote walikuwa chini ya uongozi wa baba yao kwa ajili ya muziki katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa matoazi, zeze na vinubi, katika huduma ya nyumba ya Mungu. Asafu, Yeduthuni na Hemani walihudumu chini ya uongozi wa mfalme.
sw.R: Watu hawa wote waliongozwa na baba zao wenyewe katika kupiga muziki katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walipiga matoazi, zeze na vinubi kama sehemu ya huduma katika nyumba ya Mungu. Asafu, Yeduthuni na Hemani walipokea maelekezo kutoka kwa mfalme.

vi.L: Tất cả những người này [ở] dưới tay cha họ trong việc ca hát [tại] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, với chập chõa, đàn hạc và đàn lia, cho việc phục vụ nhà của Đức Chúa Trời, dưới tay vua: A-sáp, Giê-đu-thun và Hê-man.
vi.B: Tất cả những người này đều ở dưới sự hướng dẫn của cha mình trong việc ca hát tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, với chập chõa, đàn hạc và đàn lia, trong việc phục vụ nhà của Đức Chúa Trời. A-sáp, Giê-đu-thun và Hê-man phục vụ theo sự hướng dẫn của vua.
vi.R: Tất cả những người này đều do chính cha mình hướng dẫn trong việc ca hát tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ chơi chập chõa, đàn hạc và đàn lia trong công việc phục vụ nhà của Đức Chúa Trời. A-sáp, Giê-đu-thun và Hê-man nhận sự chỉ dẫn của vua.

ko.L: 이들은 모두 그들의 아버지의 손 아래서 심벌즈와 비파와 수금으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 노래하며 하나님의 집의 섬기는 일을 했다. 왕의 손 아래에는 아삽과 여두둔과 헤만이 [있었다].
ko.B: 이들은 모두 아버지의 지휘를 받아 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 연주하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 노래했고, 하나님의 집에서 섬기는 일을 했다. 아삽과 여두둔과 헤만은 왕의 지시를 받았다.
ko.R: 이 사람들은 모두 저마다 자기 아버지의 지휘를 받아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 음악을 연주했다. 그들은 심벌즈와 비파와 수금을 연주하며 하나님의 성전에서 섬겼다. 아삽과 여두둔과 헤만은 왕의 지시를 받았다.

pt.L: Todos estes [estavam] sob as mãos do seu pai para o canto [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, com címbalos, harpas e liras, para o serviço da casa de Deus, sob as mãos do rei: Asafe, e Jedutum, e Hemã.
pt.B: Todos esses estavam sob a direção do seu pai para a música na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, com címbalos, harpas e liras, no serviço da casa de Deus. Asafe, Jedutum e Hemã serviam sob a direção do rei.
pt.R: Todos esses homens eram dirigidos pelo próprio pai para fazer música na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eles tocavam címbalos, harpas e liras como parte do serviço na casa de Deus. Asafe, Jedutum e Hemã recebiam as orientações do rei.

decisions.choice: their father: each son under his own father
decisions.reason: "All these" gathers the sons of all three families (verses 2-5), and each group worked under its own father: Asaph, Jeduthun or Heman.

decisions.choice: Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman: under the king's direction
decisions.reason: The three names at the end most likely go with "under the hands of the king": the fathers directed their sons, and the king directed the fathers (verse 2). They could also simply name the three fathers just mentioned, but the sense comes out the same.

decisions.choice: the song in the house of the LORD: music in temple worship
decisions.reason: Song here means the whole work of music, sung and played, in the worship of the sanctuary. The temple was not yet built; David was organizing its service in advance (1 Chronicles 22:5; 23:5).

decisions.choice: Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman served at the king's direction
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the three names the subject of a new sentence, following the reading in m2.

decisions.choice: their own fathers
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that each son served under his own father.

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י מִסְפָּרָם֙ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם מְלֻמְּדֵי־שִׁ֖יר לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־הַ֨מֵּבִ֔ין מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was their number with their brothers, trained [in] song to Yahweh, all the understanding [ones], two hundred eighty and eight.

en.L: And their number with their brothers, trained [in] song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the skilled, was 288.
en.B: Their number, together with their relatives who were trained in singing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all of them skilled, was 288.
en.R: Together with their relatives, there were 288 men trained to sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all of them skilled musicians.

es.L: Y su número con sus hermanos, instruidos en el canto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos los entendidos, fue de 288.
es.B: Su número, junto con sus parientes instruidos en cantar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos ellos expertos, era de 288.
es.R: Junto con sus parientes, había 288 hombres preparados para cantar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos ellos músicos expertos.

fr.L: Et leur nombre, avec leurs frères exercés au chant pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous les experts, fut de 288.
fr.B: Leur nombre, avec leurs frères exercés à chanter pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous des experts, était de 288.
fr.R: Avec les hommes de leur famille, il y avait 288 hommes formés pour chanter pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, tous des musiciens experts.

sw.L: Na hesabu yao pamoja na ndugu zao, waliofundishwa wimbo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wote wenye ustadi, ilikuwa 288.
sw.B: Idadi yao, pamoja na ndugu zao waliofundishwa kumwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wote wakiwa stadi, ilikuwa 288.
sw.R: Pamoja na ndugu zao, walikuwa watu 288 waliofundishwa kumwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wote wakiwa wanamuziki stadi.

vi.L: Số của họ cùng với anh em họ, những người đã được luyện tập ca hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tất cả những người thành thạo, là 288.
vi.B: Số của họ cùng với bà con, là những người đã được luyện tập ca hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tất cả đều thành thạo, là 288 người.
vi.R: Cùng với bà con của họ, có 288 người được luyện tập để ca hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ai nấy đều là nhạc công giỏi.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하도록 훈련받은 그들의 형제들과 함께 그들의 수는 모두 능숙한 자 288[명이었다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하도록 훈련받은 그들의 친족들과 함께, 능숙한 사람들의 수가 모두 288명이었다.
ko.R: 그들과 그들의 친척들을 합해, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하도록 훈련받은 사람이 288명이었다. 그들은 모두 솜씨 좋은 음악가들이었다.

pt.L: E o número deles, com os seus irmãos, treinados no canto {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, todos os entendidos, foi 288.
pt.B: O número deles, junto com os seus parentes treinados no canto {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, todos eles hábeis, foi 288.
pt.R: Junto com os seus parentes, havia 288 homens treinados para cantar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, todos eles músicos hábeis.

decisions.choice: brothers: relatives and fellow Levites
decisions.reason: The word "brothers" covers kinsmen in a wider sense than sons of the same parents: here the other Levites of the musicians' families who worked with them.

decisions.choice: trained in song; the skilled: taught and expert musicians
decisions.reason: The first word means "taught", the second "one who understands". Together they describe musicians who had learned their craft and were masters of it (compare 15:22, where Chenaniah directs the music "because he understood it").

decisions.choice: 288: twenty-four groups of twelve
decisions.reason: The number is twenty-four times twelve. Verses 9-31 divide the musicians into twenty-four groups of twelve, matching the twenty-four divisions of priests in chapter 24.

decisions.choice: brothers (Literal); relatives (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word; Balanced and Readable give its wider sense here. The same pattern is used in verses 9-31.

decisions.choice: 288 men; skilled musicians
decisions.reason: Readable adds "men" and "musicians" to make the count and the skill clear.

decisions.choice: "형제들" (L); "친족들" (B); "친척들" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English moves from "brothers" to "relatives"; the same wording is used in verses 9-31.

decisions.choice: os seus irmãos (L); os seus parentes (B, R); 288
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and as 15:5 in Portuguese: "irmãos" at Literal and "parentes" at Balanced and Readable, through verse 31. The total is not a round number, so it stays in figures, as 15:10 writes 112.

source.text: וַיַּפִּ֜ילוּ גּוֹרָל֣וֹת מִשְׁמֶ֗רֶת לְעֻמַּת֙ כַּקָּטֹ֣ן כַּגָּד֔וֹל מֵבִ֖ין עִם־תַּלְמִֽיד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they cast lots [of] duty, corresponding, as the small as the great, understanding [one] with pupil.

en.L: And they cast lots [for] duty, side by side, as the small so the great, teacher with pupil.
en.B: They cast lots for their duties on equal terms, small and great alike, teacher and pupil alike.
en.R: They drew lots to decide the order of their duties. Everyone was treated the same, young and old, teacher and student.

es.L: Y echaron suertes [para] los cargos, uno junto a otro, tanto el pequeño como el grande, el maestro con el discípulo.
es.B: Echaron suertes para sus cargos en igualdad de condiciones, pequeños y grandes por igual, maestros y discípulos por igual.
es.R: Echaron suertes para decidir el orden de sus tareas. A todos se los trató igual, jóvenes y mayores, maestros y alumnos.

fr.L: Et ils tirèrent au sort [leur] service, côte à côte, le petit comme le grand, le maître avec l’élève.
fr.B: Ils tirèrent au sort l’ordre de leur service, à égalité, petits et grands, maîtres et élèves.
fr.R: Ils ont tiré au sort l’ordre de leur service. Tous ont été traités de la même manière, jeunes et vieux, maîtres et élèves.

sw.L: Wakapiga kura [kwa ajili ya] zamu, sawa kwa sawa, mdogo kama mkubwa, mwalimu pamoja na mwanafunzi.
sw.B: Walipiga kura kwa ajili ya zamu zao kwa usawa, mdogo na mkubwa vilevile, mwalimu na mwanafunzi vilevile.
sw.R: Walipiga kura kuamua mpangilio wa zamu zao. Kila mtu alitendewa sawa, kijana na mzee, mwalimu na mwanafunzi.

vi.L: Họ bắt thăm [phân] phiên, ngang nhau, nhỏ cũng như lớn, thầy cũng như trò.
vi.B: Họ bắt thăm để định phiên phục vụ một cách ngang nhau, nhỏ cũng như lớn, thầy cũng như trò.
vi.R: Họ bắt thăm để định thứ tự các phiên phục vụ. Mọi người đều được đối xử như nhau, trẻ cũng như già, thầy cũng như trò.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 작은 자나 큰 자나, 스승이나 제자나 똑같이 직무를 위해 제비를 뽑았다.
ko.B: 그들은 작은 사람이나 큰 사람이나, 스승이나 제자나 똑같이 직무를 정하려고 제비를 뽑았다.
ko.R: 그들은 제비를 뽑아 맡을 일의 순서를 정했다. 젊은 사람이나 나이 든 사람이나, 가르치는 사람이나 배우는 사람이나 모두 똑같이 대우받았다.

pt.L: E lançaram sortes para os turnos, lado a lado, tanto o pequeno como o grande, o mestre com o aprendiz.
pt.B: Eles lançaram sortes para os seus turnos em pé de igualdade, pequenos e grandes, mestres e aprendizes igualmente.
pt.R: Eles lançaram sortes para decidir a ordem dos seus turnos. Todos foram tratados da mesma forma, jovens e velhos, mestres e alunos.

decisions.choice: cast lots for duty: chose the order of service by lot
decisions.reason: Lots were drawn to leave a choice to God rather than to human favor (Proverbs 16:33). Here they set the order in which the twenty-four groups would take turns at the sanctuary, as the priests' turns were set in 24:5-19. The word for "duty" means a turn or watch of service.

decisions.choice: side by side, small and great alike: no one was given an advantage
decisions.reason: The phrase means on equal terms, as in 24:31. "Small and great" may mean young and old or lower and higher in rank; either way, all were treated alike.

decisions.choice: teacher with pupil
decisions.reason: The first word is the same as "the skilled" in verse 7: the master musician. The second, "pupil", is found only here in the Hebrew Bible and comes from the verb "learn".

decisions.choice: young and old
decisions.reason: Readable takes "small and great" as young and old, the most natural sense in a list of teachers and learners.

decisions.choice: lançaram sortes; os turnos
decisions.reason: "Lançar sortes" as set at 24:5. The duty is a turn of service at the sanctuary (m1), "o turno", the word 23:6 keeps for the turn itself, while the group that takes it is "a turma".

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֧ל הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן לְאָסָ֖ף לְיוֹסֵ֑ף גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י הֽוּא־וְאֶחָ֥יו וּבָנָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out the lot the first for Asaph to Joseph; Gedaliah the second, he and his brothers and his sons, two ten.

en.L: And the first lot went out for Asaph, to Joseph; Gedaliah the second, he and his brothers and his sons, twelve.
en.B: The first lot fell for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his relatives and his sons, twelve.
en.R: The first lot fell to Joseph, from Asaph's family. The second fell to Gedaliah, with his relatives and sons, twelve men in all.

es.L: Y la primera suerte salió para Asaf, para José; Gedalías el segundo, él y sus hermanos y sus hijos, doce.
es.B: La primera suerte le tocó, de los de Asaf, a José; la segunda a Gedalías, él con sus parientes y sus hijos, doce.
es.R: La primera suerte le tocó a José, de la familia de Asaf. La segunda le tocó a Gedalías, con sus parientes e hijos, doce hombres en total.

fr.L: Et le premier sort sortit, pour Asaph, à Joseph ; Guedalia le deuxième, lui, et ses frères, et ses fils, douze.
fr.B: Le premier sort tomba, pour Asaph, sur Joseph ; le deuxième sur Guedalia, lui, ses frères et ses fils, douze.
fr.R: Le premier sort est tombé sur Joseph, de la famille d’Asaph. Le deuxième est tombé sur Guedalia, avec ses frères et ses fils, douze hommes en tout.

sw.L: Kura ya kwanza ikatoka kwa Asafu, kwa Yusufu; Gedalia wa pili, yeye na ndugu zake na wanawe, kumi na wawili.
sw.B: Kura ya kwanza ya Asafu ilimwangukia Yusufu; ya pili Gedalia, yeye na ndugu zake na wanawe, kumi na wawili.
sw.R: Kura ya kwanza ilimwangukia Yusufu, wa jamaa ya Asafu. Ya pili ilimwangukia Gedalia, pamoja na ndugu zake na wanawe, watu kumi na wawili kwa jumla.

vi.L: Thăm thứ nhất ra cho A-sáp, trúng Giô-sép; thứ hai Ghê-đa-lia, ông cùng anh em và các con trai ông, mười hai [người].
vi.B: Thăm thứ nhất thuộc về A-sáp trúng Giô-sép; thăm thứ hai trúng Ghê-đa-lia, ông cùng bà con và các con trai ông, mười hai người.
vi.R: Thăm thứ nhất trúng Giô-sép, thuộc gia đình A-sáp. Thăm thứ hai trúng Ghê-đa-lia, cùng bà con và các con trai ông, tất cả là mười hai người.

ko.L: 그리고 첫째 제비가 아삽에게서 요셉에게 나왔고, 둘째는 그달리야, 그와 그의 형제들과 그의 아들들, 열두 [명].
ko.B: 첫째 제비는 아삽 집안의 요셉에게 나왔다. 둘째 제비는 그달리야에게 나왔다. 그와 그의 친족들과 아들들이 열두 명이었다.
ko.R: 첫째 제비로 아삽 집안의 요셉이 뽑혔다. 둘째 제비로 그달리야가 뽑혔다. 그와 그의 친척들과 아들들을 합해 모두 열두 명이었다.

pt.L: E saiu a primeira sorte, de Asafe, para José; Gedalias, a segunda, ele e os seus irmãos e os seus filhos, doze.
pt.B: A primeira sorte, da parte de Asafe, caiu para José; a segunda para Gedalias, ele, os seus parentes e os seus filhos, doze.
pt.R: A primeira sorte caiu para José, da família de Asafe. A segunda caiu para Gedalias, com os seus parentes e filhos, doze homens ao todo.

decisions.choice: the lot came out: the lot was drawn
decisions.reason: The lot "going out" means that it was drawn from a container or thrown down, naming who would serve in that turn (24:7; Numbers 33:54; Joshua 19:1).

decisions.choice: for Asaph to Joseph: Joseph, of Asaph's family
decisions.reason: "For Asaph" names the family, "to Joseph" the son who received the lot (verse 2). The other lots name only the son.

decisions.choice: Joseph's group: the count of twelve is not given
decisions.reason: Every other lot ends with "his sons and his brothers, twelve", but Joseph's has no such words. The words were probably lost in copying; the old Greek translation has them. Twenty-four groups of twelve make the 288 of verse 7, so Joseph's group was twelve too. The Hebrew is kept as it stands.

decisions.choice: he and his brothers and his sons
decisions.reason: This first full entry names the leader himself with his group; the entries that follow say only "his sons and his brothers". Twelve is the size of each group, leader included.

decisions.choice: twelve men in all
decisions.reason: Readable adds "men" and "in all" to show that twelve is the size of each group. The same words are used in verses 10-31.

decisions.choice: one formula for the twenty-four lots
decisions.reason: Each level keeps one wording through verses 9-31: L follows the Hebrew's small changes ("para", "[la]"), B "La Nª a X, sus hijos y sus parientes, doce", R "La Nª suerte le tocó a X, con sus hijos y parientes, doce hombres en total".

decisions.choice: "le Ne sur X, ses fils et ses frères, douze" (B); "Le Ne sort est tombé sur X, avec ses fils et ses frères, douze hommes en tout" (R)
decisions.reason: One formula per level for the twenty-four lots, as in chapter 24; "frères" is kept at every level for the kinsmen of the group, since French "frères" is used this way of members of a guild.

decisions.choice: one formula for the twenty-four lots: "[Kura] ya N, X, wanawe na ndugu zake, kumi na wawili" (L); "Ya N ilimwangukia X" (B); "Kura ya N ilimwangukia X ... watu kumi na wawili kwa jumla" (R)
alternatives: a different wording for each lot
decisions.reason: As in chapter 24, the list of lots keeps one wording per level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Thăm thứ N trúng X, ... mười hai người"
decisions.reason: The lot formula of 24:7-18 is kept for the musicians' twenty-four lots in verses 9-31.

decisions.choice: the lot formula of 24:7: "saiu a primeira sorte" (L), "a primeira sorte caiu para" (B, R); and for verses 10-31 "A terceira, Zacur, os seus filhos e os seus irmãos, doze" (L), "A terceira para Zacur, os seus filhos e os seus parentes, doze" (B), "A terceira sorte caiu para Zacur, com os seus filhos e parentes, doze homens ao todo" (R)
decisions.reason: The singers' lots keep the Portuguese of the priests' lots in 24:7, so that the two lists read alike. As the English (r-en-1 of verse 10), each level keeps one wording for the short entries of verses 10-31, and Literal follows the Hebrew's "para" and its plain numbers where the English does.

source.text: הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֣י זַכּ֔וּר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

records.literal_gloss: The third Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, two ten.

en.L: The third, Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
en.B: The third to Zaccur, his sons and his relatives, twelve.
